hooks.command: jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty' | { read -r f; case "${f##*/}" in .env.example|.env.sample|.env.template|*.example|*.sample|*.template) exit 0;; esac; case "$f" in */.env|*/.env.*|*/.envrc|*/credentials.json|*/.credentials.json|*.pem|*.key|*/settings.local.json) echo '{"decision":"block","reason":"Blocked: sensitive file"}'; exit 0;; esac; exit 0; }

allow: Bash(op read:*) # 1Password CLI secret reads are routine in this project (op used 9x in transcripts, 8x in shell history) — covered by Standard Credentials default only for env injection; explicit reads via op CLI are a common local workflow pattern
Bash(kubectl get:*) # kubectl read-only inspection of cluster state — kubectl observed 2x in project transcripts for namespace-scoped operations
soft_deny: Bash(pnpm *-prod*) # pnpm scripts connecting to production upstream (membership-details-prod, provider-resolutions-prod, membership-details-uat:prod, provider-resolutions-uat:prod) — these hit live production data even if read-only per CLAUDE.md
Bash(kubectl * -n *prod*) # kubectl commands targeting any namespace with prod in the name
